Command: Do no servile work on the eighth day of Tabernacles
Summary: On the eighth day, the solemn assembly after Tabernacles, no servile work may be done.
Commandment: On the eighth day of Tabernacles, do no servile work.
Application: The moral/ceremonial/civil division is a traditional classification, not Scripture's own division; this law is traditionally classed as ceremonial. The eighth day's ban closed the feast season with a separate solemn assembly. Debated: some see the commanded observance fulfilled as shadow (Colossians 2:16-17); others keep feasts voluntarily as memorial, not as binding command. The site does not settle whether observance continues.
Purpose: To rehearse God's saving acts at appointed seasons (Leviticus 23); Paul calls Christ our Passover (1 Corinthians 5:7).
